how.heading: Find your fixer in three steps
how.intro: Search, compare, book. The shop quotes before any work starts, and the job closes with a warranty recorded against it.
how.step1Body: Filter by repair type, minimum rating, minimum warranty and service option — in-shop, home visit or pickup. Every predicate runs in the database, not on your device.
how.step2Body: Every listing shows a live opening-hours readout in the shop's own timezone. Not a stale table — the dot you see is accurate to the minute.
how.step3Body: Pick a slot and the shop accepts and quotes before touching your device. The job closes with a warranty window recorded against it.

why.heading: FixGrid is built for the repair economy
why.localBody: Every shop is a real business with a real address — not a national chain or a remote call centre.
why.verifiedBody: Verified shops have had their address, phone number and opening hours confirmed by the FixGrid team.
why.liveBody: Opening hours are stored per-day, per-timezone and rendered in real time — not cached from last month.
why.repairBody: Every repair is an item that doesn't go to landfill. FixGrid exists because fixing things is worth doing.

join.metaDescription: Add your repair business to FixGrid. Free to list, no booking fees, and your dashboard opens as soon as you submit.
join.heading: List your repair shop
join.intro: FixGrid is a directory of repair shops people can actually book. Listing is free, there are no booking fees, and you keep control of your own hours and prices.
join.benefit1Body: Add services, opening hours and photos the moment you submit — no waiting on us to start building your page.
join.benefit2Body: A person reviews your details before the listing goes live. It keeps the directory worth trusting, which is what makes it worth being in.
join.benefit3Title: Bookings, not just a phone number
join.benefit3Body: Customers request a slot against your real availability. You accept, decline or propose another time.
join.claim: Already listed but not the owner? <find>Find your shop</find> and claim it instead — that keeps your existing reviews.
join.signInBody: A shop has to belong to an account — that is what gives you the dashboard, your bookings and your messages. It takes a minute.
